Summary: AE-SIGNUP-006 - Verify the complete registration workflow including optional subscription selections
Description:
Module: Signup
Requirement ID: REQ-AUTH-001
Source: RTM coverage-gap remediation
Environment: QA | automationexercise.com
Preconditions: Automation Exercise is available; user is logged out; a unique disposable email is available.
Test Data: Unique QA name and email; safe account details; newsletter and special-offer selections enabled.
Test Steps:
1. Open automationexercise.com and select Signup / Login.
2. Start signup with a valid name and unique email.
3. Complete all required account fields.
4. Select Sign up for our newsletter and Receive special offers from our partners.
5. Create the account and continue to the home page.
6. Verify Logged in as is displayed.
7. Delete the disposable account as cleanup.
Expected Result: The account is created successfully, the user is authenticated, optional selections do not block registration, and cleanup succeeds.

Summary: AE-ORDER-001 - Verify an order can be placed after registering during checkout
Description:
Module: Checkout
Requirement ID: REQ-ORDER-001
Source: RTM coverage-gap remediation
Environment: QA | automationexercise.com
Preconditions: Automation Exercise is available; user is logged out; cart is empty; a unique email is available.
Test Data: One in-stock product; unique QA account data; safe test payment data supplied by the site scenario.
Test Steps:
1. Add a product to the cart.
2. Open Cart and select Proceed To Checkout.
3. Choose Register / Login.
4. Create and confirm a new account.
5. Return to Cart and proceed to checkout.
6. Verify address and order details.
7. Enter an order comment and place the order.
8. Enter test payment details and confirm.
9. Verify the success message and delete the disposable account.
Expected Result: The newly registered user completes checkout and sees the order success confirmation.

Summary: AE-CATALOG-001 - Verify category and subcategory navigation displays matching products

Source: RTM coverage-gap remediation
Environment: QA | automationexercise.com
Preconditions: Automation Exercise home page is available.
Test Data: Women > Dress and Men > Tshirts category examples.

2. Expand Women and select Dress.
3. Verify the Women - Dress Products heading and relevant products.

Summary: AE-CATALOG-002 - Verify brand navigation and switching displays products for the selected brand
Description:
Module: Products
Requirement ID: REQ-CATALOG-002
Source: RTM coverage-gap remediation
Environment: QA | automationexercise.com
Preconditions: Automation Exercise Products page is available.
Test Data: Two brands shown in the Brands panel, such as Polo and H&M.
Test Steps:
1. Open Products and verify the Brands panel.
2. Select the first brand and verify the brand-products heading and results.

Summary: AE-CART-004 - Verify searched products remain in the cart after login
Description:
Module: Cart
Requirement ID: REQ-CART-004
Source: RTM coverage-gap remediation
Environment: QA | automationexercise.com
Preconditions: A dedicated QA account exists and is logged out; cart is empty.
Test Data: Search term matching multiple products; valid QA credentials.
Test Steps:
1. Open Products and search for a product term.
2. Verify Searched Products and add visible results to the cart.
3. Open Cart and record the products.
4. Select Signup / Login and authenticate.
5. Return to Cart.
6. Compare product names, prices, quantities, and totals with the pre-login cart.
Expected Result: All products added before login remain in the cart with unchanged details after authentication.

Summary: AE-ORDER-004 - Verify checkout delivery and billing addresses match the registered account
Description:
Module: Checkout
Requirement ID: REQ-ORDER-004
Source: RTM coverage-gap remediation
Environment: QA | automationexercise.com
Preconditions: A registered QA user is logged in and has at least one product in the cart.
Test Data: Known QA registration address and one in-stock product.
Test Steps:
1. Proceed from Cart to Checkout.
2. Compare Delivery Address with the registered account data.
3. Compare Billing Address with the registered account data.
4. Verify name, company if supplied, street, city/state/ZIP, country, and phone fields.
Expected Result: Delivery and billing sections display the correct registered account address details without omissions or unexpected changes.

Summary: AE-ORDER-005 - Verify an invoice can be downloaded after a successful purchase
Description:
Module: Checkout
Requirement ID: REQ-ORDER-005
Source: RTM coverage-gap remediation
Environment: QA | automationexercise.com
Preconditions: A registered QA user is logged in and can complete checkout.
Test Data: One in-stock product and safe test payment data.
Test Steps:
1. Add a product and complete checkout.
2. Verify the order success message.
3. Select Download Invoice.
4. Confirm a file downloads.
5. Open the invoice and compare order/product details with the completed purchase.
6. Select Continue.
Expected Result: A readable invoice downloads after purchase and contains details consistent with the completed order.
